title: Why Your Brain Wiring is Crossed (The 500-Million-Year Glitch)
angle: Your right hand is controlled by your left brain, and your left leg by your right. Why on Earth did evolution cross the wiring of every vertebrate on the planet? Here is the answer.
outline: Hook: The bizarre reality of decussation: Every vertebrate on Earth has an inverted nervous system.
The Somatic Twist Hypothesis: How ancient ancestral chordates flipped upside down relative to insects.
The Optic Chiasm: Why crossing optic nerves prevented inverted vision as eyes moved forward.
The Predator-Escape Reflex: How cross-wired motor pathways allowed faster ipsilateral evasive turns.
The medical implications: Why strokes on one side of the brain paralyze the opposite side of the body.

title: Why Killer Whales Started Sinking Luxury Yachts

Cultural transmission in cetaceans: How teenage killer whales copy pod fads across generations.
Conservation solutions: Acoustic deterrents, non-damaging rudder modifications, and safe transit routes.

title: Why Crows Make Decisions Twice as Fast as Humans

What corvid intelligence proves about convergent evolution of intelligence across completely different brain architectures.

title: The 50-Foot River Monster: How Science Proved Spinosaurus Was Aquatic

Why an aquatic lifestyle allowed Spinosaurus to reach 15 meters and surpass T-Rex in body length.

title: What Asteroid Bennu's Rocks Reveal About Jupiter's Ancient Rampage

outline: Hook: Asteroid Bennu isn't from where we thought—it was thrown into the inner solar system during the wildest era of planetary history.
